verse.verse_1: Recite thou in the name of thy Lord Who hath created -
verse.verse_2: Hath created man from a clot!
verse.verse_3: Recite thou: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
verse.verse_4: Who hath taught mankind by the pen -
verse.verse_5: Hath taught man that which he knew not.
verse.verse_6: By no means: Verily man exorbitateth.
verse.verse_8: Verily Unto thy Lord is the return.
verse.verse_10: A bondman of Ours when he prayeth *
verse.verse_11: Bethinkest thou, if he is himself guided,
verse.verse_13: Bethinkest thou, if he belieth and turneth away?
verse.verse_14: Knoweth he not that Allah beholdeth?
verse.verse_15: By no means! If he desist not We shall seize and deal him by the forelock -
verse.verse_17: Then, let him call his assembly,
verse.verse_18: We also shall call the infernal guards.
verse.verse_19: By no means! Obey not thou him. Continue to adore, and continue to draw nigh.
